findings.title: Unrelated cleanup interval change from 10m to 1m
findings.body: pkg/services/cleanup/cleanup.go changes the background ticker from time.Minute*10 to time.Minute*1. This runs all cleanup jobs (snapshots, dashboard versions, images, annotations, invites, short URLs, query history) 10x more often, increasing DB/CPU load and potentially worsening the MySQL deadlock this PR tries to fix. The PR description never mentions this change, so it looks like leftover debug code and should be reverted.

findings.title: Leftover error-level debug logging with full ID lists
findings.body: pkg/services/annotations/annotationsimpl/xorm_store.go logs at Error level on every cleanup batch in CleanAnnotations and CleanOrphanedAnnotationTags, including the full ids slice (up to AnnotationCleanupJobBatchSize, e.g. 32767 IDs) plus cond and err which is nil on success. This floods error logs with hundreds of KB per batch, triggers error alerts for normal operation, and wastes CPU. These are leftover debug statements and should be removed or demoted to Debug without dumping IDs.

findings.title: Quadratic string building for large SQLite IN clause
findings.body: pkg/services/annotations/annotationsimpl/xorm_store.go builds the SQLite DELETE IN list with values = fmt.Sprintf("%s, %d", values, v) inside a loop over ids. This copies the growing string on every iteration, giving O(n^2) time and allocations. With batch sizes up to 32767 as in the new test this builds a ~200KB statement by copying gigabytes total, slowing cleanup. Use strings.Builder, strings.Join, or strconv.AppendInt instead.
